# Sheet

A panel that slides in from an edge.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Only dialogs separate from the page here, with a dimmed page and a border. A panel sliding in from an edge adds a layer the scheme does not use. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./dialog">Dialog</a>, <a href="./collapsible">Collapsible</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Filters, details or a secondary form while the page stays in view.
- **Not when:** A blocking decision (dialog), or a tiny confirmation.

Instead:

- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A centered blocking window.
- [Drawer](./drawer.md): The bottom panel for phones.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> A strong border and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A shadow only</div></div><div class="cap">The dimmed page makes the dialog obvious.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Escape closes it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It behaves as a dialog: named, focus moves in and back. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sheet
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
